verdicts.reason: A fills the tall format and keeps all text readable. But its alignment is mixed: the orange headline and the teal line are left-aligned at arbitrary indents while the body is centred, and the teal line nearly touches the right edge. The body copy is also larger than the headline, and the contact block is jammed under the teal line. B is badly underscaled: the headline sits flush-left while everything else is centred, the dividers and body float in large dead gaps, and the phone and website fine print is too small to read.
